_doc: Recordationem editorial overrides. Layered on top of every discovery run by recordationem.py so editors keep control without code changes. Manage this file via /recordationem-admin.html (Export overrides) or by hand.

<topic_id>.approved: boolean — set false to hide a discovered topic
<topic_id>.archived: boolean — set true to archive a completed story
<topic_id>.title: string — override the auto-generated title
notes: string — contextual editor notes shown on the story page
